_comment: boxrun_speed — Mystery Box farm with the +17% base speed Random Boost, jump-hop run, play to death (no early quit). Clone of boxrun_magnet with the Magnetic Aura buy chain swapped for the speed one: probe_speed/start_run read speedbase17_banner.png (CV-verified 2026-08-02: equipped=1.000, shop-without=0.348, home=0.377), buy_speed taps the pink Multi toggle (1649,337) DIRECTLY — the speed chain needs no Random Boost cell tap, unlike magnet — and picker's Multi-Buy sits at (953,899) instead of (950,880). Coords lifted from the boxrun_default profile (also encoded in src/boost.py's 'speed' profile) that proved them live. Deliberately a standalone config rather than `run_toggle.py --boost speed`: boxrun_toggle.json taps Play at (1431,963), the top-left CORNER of the Play! marker (its true centre is ~1530,1004), which misses often enough that the boost shop never opens and the whole buy chain is skipped — observed live 2026-08-02 across ~700 cycles with await_shop scoring 0.53-0.62 (i.e. still looking at home) and no purchase ever made. This config keeps boxrun_magnet's proven Play tap at (1650,970). PRECONDITION: any episode selected on home BEFORE starting (bot only taps Play!). Fast Start prompt spam-tapped at run start. Cookie Relay Boost tap (960,540) once per hop. Boxes collected mid-run are opened on the Mystery Box screen after Result. Loop: home->Play->await_shop->probe_speed->buy_speed->picker->wait_roll->start_run->check_heart->Play->run(J->J->S->J till death)->run_result->mystery_box->reveal->home. RELAY MISS FIX (2026-08-09): live-caught on boxrun_speed — the 'Save the Cookie' Pit-Lift-purchase screen (mid-run near-death prompt, 'X for 1 Pit Lift' bar) can appear the SAME instant as the Cookie Relay prompt; the relay text was genuinely on screen (watcher score 0.72, above the 0.62 threshold) but the bot's own poll landed on the frame just before it rendered and read absent, then walked straight to the next hop without rechecking — the relay was gone by the time the chain came back around. All relay_stage1/2_* and relay_poll1/2_* states now carry absent_retries=2/absent_wait_ms=400 (~2.8s grace incl. poll overhead, same mechanism probe_dc_owned already used) so a same-frame miss gets rechecked in place instead of being abandoned for a whole hop cycle.

home._note: Main menu, detected by the episode-independent 'Play!' button (home/home_play_marker.png — see coinrun.json for why the old Episode-banner marker silently broke). Play! visible = nothing covers it, tap it. Absent -> a modal covers it or we're elsewhere: hand off to probe_sendlife (NEVER blind-tap from here). 3000ms wait covers the boost-shop fade-in before await_shop re-checks. Play! at (1650,970). Play! at (1650,970) -> await_shop. No home-spam and no after_play gate: after_play misread the Play! button showing THROUGH the shop fade (~0.87) as a missed tap and double-tapped Play, which closed the shop. Fast Start is spammed later (await_shop absent = direct run, or check_heart = shop path) — always AFTER we have left home, so it can never hit the leaderboard.

await_shop._note: After Play, poll for the boost shop. It settles to 1.00 within ~1s WHEN Play was tapped on a stable home; if home was still fading the tap can miss, so retry 6x/700ms. Shop present -> probe_speed. Absent after retries = direct run (boost still equipped, no shop) -> spam the Fast Start spot (985,515) across the prompt window (safe now: we are off home) -> running.

probe_dailycheckin._note: New head of the modal-peeling chain. The 'Daily Check-in' calendar pops ONCE per day at first launch and sits ON TOP of home, hiding Play! — with no dismiss the whole bot stalls here (observed live: run loop never resumed). Detected by the unique 'Daily Check-in' banner title (dailycheckin_marker: self=1.000, in-run frame=0.232 — no false-positive). Present -> tap the green OK button (965,985, CV-located from the button's green blob) -> home re-checks. Absent -> fall to probe_sendlife, the rest of the chain unchanged.

probe_treasurereward._note: The 'Power+ Treasure Rewards' popup stacks right after Daily Check-in at launch (Choco Dip Sticks / Crystal Crown etc.), also covering Play!. Same stall class as the check-in: no dismiss -> bot loses home. Detected by the unique 'Power+ Treasure Rewards' title (marker self=1.000, in-run=0.31, vs dailycheckin=0.40 — no cross-match). Present -> tap Confirm (960,850) -> home. Absent -> fall to probe_sendlife. Reached from BOTH the check-in dismiss (popups queue) and directly when only this one shows.

probe_sendlife._note: Reached whenever Play! is not visible and no Daily Check-in popup was on screen. 'Send <friend> a free Life?' dialog pops over home when a stray tap lands on a leaderboard friend row. Tap Cancel (727,688 — gray, left); NEVER Confirm (1189,687). Detected by the unique 'Gift Points' text. Dismissed -> home. Absent -> try the boost shop next.

boost_shop._note: Boost shop open (entry point for guard/probe re-routing). Route to probe_speed to ensure +17% base speed is equipped before Play.

picker._note: 'Pick desired Boosts!' popup. '+17% base speed' stays PRE-TICKED — DO NOT tap any row (each toggles). Tap Multi-Buy ONCE at (953,899) — the speed picker's button sits lower than the magnet one (950,880). The game AUTO-ROLLS, spending coins, until the +17% boost lands, then stops. Hand to wait_roll. ABSENT -> picker never opened -> settle-retry then retry_buy. TICK GUARD (2026-08-02): the rows are toggles and the game REMEMBERS ticks across sessions, so 'the boost we want is pre-ticked' is only true until something else changes it — another bot config, a --boost run through run_toggle.py, or a manual tap. Found live with '+17% base speed' ticked and Magnetic Aura/Double Coins NOT, which would make Multi-Buy roll for the wrong boost, start_run's banner check fail, and retry_buy re-roll until the coins ran out. The prelude below now clears every other row and ticks ours before Multi-Buy, mirroring what src/boost.py's apply_boost injects for the toggle family. Each tap is `optional` + roi-scoped: 'template absent' means the row is already in the wanted state, so it is a no-op, not an error.

wait_roll._note: The self-rolling Multi-Buy is in progress: the game keeps re-rolling and spending coins until Magnetic Aura lands, showing a Stop button (rollstop_marker, self=1.000; settled/Play frame=0.37) the whole time. Do NOTHING — no taps — just self-loop while the Stop button is present so we never cut the roll short. The ep3 multibuy_marker did NOT match ep6 roll UI, so wait_roll exited instantly, start_run read a still-rolling (Magnetic-Aura-absent) banner, and the loop re-bought forever. Stop gone -> roll finished -> read the banner in start_run. absent (Stop gone) is a goto to a DIFFERENT state (start_run) so the self-loop + timeout is safe. match_timeout_ms 90000 bounds a roll UI stuck matched forever — the state's timeout_ms only ever fired on the absent path.

insufficient_coins._note: SAFETY: 'Not enough Coins!' popup. Tap Cancel (770,685) — NEVER Confirm (1150,685), which spends gems. Then Play! with whatever boost we have (or none).

force_play._note: Coins exhausted — stop chasing the speed boost, Play! with whatever we have. Still route through check_heart so we don't run on empty hearts.

start_run._note: SPEED ENFORCEMENT: reached only AFTER wait_roll confirmed the roll UI is gone. Pill present -> the roll landed +17% base speed -> check_heart -> Play. Pill ABSENT -> the roll never landed it (or the picker never opened) -> retry_buy, which buys again until we do. The only sanctioned Play-without-speed path is the nocoins escape (insufficient_coins -> force_play). RETRY GRACE (4x800ms): after Multi-Buy the roll animation + banner render take ~2-3s; checking instantly reads a still-fading banner and loops back into buy_speed, re-rolling and burning coins.

retry_buy._note: Re-buy gate: we ended up without the +17% speed boost and must roll again. Check the wallet FIRST so we never spin on an empty balance: 'Not enough Coins!' up -> insufficient_coins (Cancel, then force_play — the ONLY sanctioned Play-without-speed path). No popup -> coins remain, loop back into buy_speed. Termination is natural (each roll drains coins until the game raises nocoins); a genuinely stuck loop trips the engine's 100-poll livelock warning.

check_heart._note: SINGLE Play gate, reached from await_shop/boost_shop (Play at 1365,931). boxrun/heart_empty.png = separator '|' + FIRST (leftmost) heart gray, cropped live at 0 hearts — hearts deplete right-to-left, so slot 1 is gray ONLY at 0 hearts. CV: 0 hearts=1.000; 1-3 hearts ~0.75 (thin margin, don't raise match_threshold). Present -> close the boost shop popup IF one is open (this state is reached via await_shop -> probe_speed with the shop possibly still open — its own tap-Play path tolerates that because Play shows through the fade, but the errands below need a clean home screen or their own detects miss everything behind the shop; live-verified 2026-08-08, the very first run through this path hung for 500+ polls on sendlife_mailbox's open_mailbox because the shop was still covering the mailbox icon). tap_template with optional=true, not close_popup: this state is also reached with --boost none (boost_skip_goto skips the shop chain entirely), where no shop popup exists at all and close_popup's unconditional blind tap at the shop's X coordinate would land on whatever home element happens to sit there instead — optional means absent is a normal outcome, not a retry target. Then run the Send-Life and mailbox-sweep errands (their own configs, each ending in their own `stop`) instead of idling here: 0 hearts means 25+ min of dead air before regen, so the wait is put to use on friend-list upkeep rather than burned sitting on a 30s self-loop. Send-Life only clears the Episode already selected on home (no episode switching — that would leave the wrong Episode selected when boxrun resumes); the mailbox sweep runs its own full loop. Then re-check check_heart: still 0 -> another errand pass; a heart regenerated meanwhile -> falls straight through to the on_absent Play path below. Absent (>=1 heart) -> tap Play then SPAM-TAP the Fast Start spot (985,515) across the prompt window into the run (blind spam, ported from boxrun_magnet — more robust than detect+tap which missed when the prompt window was short). SEND-LIFE REMOVED 2026-08-16 (user request): check_heart used to run sendlife.json (home-screen Friends tab, 19 states, one Send-Life tap per visible row) before sendlife_mailbox.json. Only the mailbox sweep runs now. The Friends-tab pass was also the expensive one — it walks a scrollable list one friend at a time and measured 1411s (23.5 min) on 2026-08-16, which together with the 138s mailbox sweep that follows it summed to 1549s and tripped this state's own match_timeout (1,554,406ms >= 1,500,000ms): run_config blocks inside the calling state, so every errand second is billed to check_heart. Post-removal the same night, the mailbox sweep alone measured 138s across a 4h39m window — an order of magnitude under the 1,500,000ms ceiling, so the ceiling now has real headroom instead of sitting just above the observed worst case.

running._note: In-run (auto-play). Result popup up -> run over. Not up -> we MIGHT still be running, but could equally be on home or in the shop, so DON'T tap yet: hand off to the guard chain.

guard_not_home._note: Guard 1/2 before any in-run tap: Play! on screen -> we're on home, not running.

guard_not_shop._note: Guard 2/2: in the boost shop -> resume via boost_shop. Neither Play! nor shop visible -> guard_not_sendlife (rule out a Send-Life/Level-Up popup before assuming genuinely mid-run and jumping blind).

guard_not_sendlife._note: Guard 3: a "Send <name> a free Life?" dialog can pop mid-loop when a stray tap grazes a leaderboard friend row (we are actually still on the Friends-tab home, not mid-run). Detect it and Cancel (727,688 — gray/left, NEVER Confirm) -> home. Absent -> guard_not_levelup. Ported from boxrun_passive.

guard_not_levelup._note: Guard 4: a "Level Up" reward popup (levelup_marker, self=1.000) can pop mid-loop from auto-play XP gain — same class as Send-Life. Confirm (959,969, same coord as probe_levelup) -> home. Absent -> genuinely mid-run -> resume the original jump/relay action (moved here from guard_not_shop) and hand to jump_2. Ported from boxrun_passive.

jump_2._note: Hop 2/4 — jump. One capture per hop, spent on the only mid-run question: result popup up? If not, jump again. RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here. RELAY (2026-08-03): the blind relay_tap here is gone. After the hop action we go through relay_stage1_jump_3/relay_stage2_jump_3, which detect the real two-stage Cookie Relay prompt and resume at jump_3 either way.

jump_3._note: Hop 3/4 — the SLIDE hop of the J->J->S->J anti-collision cycle. Overhead bars are the one obstacle class a jump can never clear; one slide per 4-hop cycle (~every 3-4s) sweeps them without giving up much pit coverage. Slide zone = the 'Slide' button bottom-right (~1671,937), press-and-hold via act.py (default ~550ms clears a typical low bar). Same detect contract: result up -> run over. RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here. RELAY (2026-08-03): the blind relay_tap here is gone. After the hop action we go through relay_stage1_jump_4/relay_stage2_jump_4, which detect the real two-stage Cookie Relay prompt and resume at jump_4 either way.

jump_4._note: Hop 4/4 — jump, last hop before a housekeeping pass through the probe chain (popups don't expire on their own; sweeping every ~4 hops clears them at a quarter of the capture cost). RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here. RELAY (2026-08-03): the blind relay_tap here is gone. After the hop action we go through relay_stage1_check_shop_after_run/relay_stage2_check_shop_after_run, which detect the real two-stage Cookie Relay prompt and resume at check_shop_after_run either way.

check_shop_after_run._note: Result popup not up yet — still running, home is back, or we're in the shop. Try home; absent -> walk the probe chain.

probe_boostshop._note: Recovery probe: sitting in the boost shop (process started there, or run ended straight into shop)? boost_shop routes to probe_speed.

probe_congrats._note: Level-up 'Congratulations!' popup (free reward). Confirm (956,846) is safe/free.

probe_levelup._note: Separate 'Level Up' popup (gems/coins/score-bonus, distinct from the Congratulations ticket popup). Confirm (959,969) is safe/free.

probe_rankingrewards._note: SAFETY NET: gold 'Ranking Rewards' season popup opened by a stray leaderboard tap. X at (1672,135), free/safe.

probe_giftdraw._note: SAFETY NET: 'Gift Draw' popup over home. Tap X (1685,170) — never Draw; the farm loop must not auto-consume gift draws.

probe_friendinfo._note:
SAFETY NET: 'Friend's ___' popup family, which can stack two layers. MEASURED LIVE 2026-08-06 (frames archived as docs/evidence/friendinfo_stacked_2layers.png and docs/evidence/friendinfo_single_layer.png):
• ONE layer ('Friend's Info' alone) — (1633,107) IS the X and closes it in a single tap, 0.974 -> 0.343.
• TWO layers ('Friend's Cookie' over 'Friend's Info') — the inner card covers (1633,107) (that pixel reads BGR 85,85,85, a shadow) and the inner X sits at about (1555,125). Tapping the outer coordinate hits nothing, so no retry count clears both layers from one coordinate.
LIVELOCK CONFIRMED (2026-08-08, live logs 02:57-03:09 and 12:51-13:04, 34 consecutive WARNINGs each episode, ~12min each): the stacked case scored 0.98 across all 3 close_popup retries because every attempt tapped the SAME outer coordinate ±10px — none ever reached the inner card's X. After exhausting retries the state gave up and jumped to `running`, which polished on relay/jump states for a mid-run screen that was never actually there, then looped back to probe_friendinfo ~15s later and repeated — an unbounded loop the log never showed as "stuck" because each pass did produce activity (taps, transitions), just none of it against the real screen.
FIX (2026-08-09): the previous note said "do NOT add a second blind tap" — correct for an UNSCOPED tap, which the 2026-08-06 attempt was and which fired on home whenever the popup was already gone (see docs/evidence for why). The fix here is different: a ROI-scoped tap_template against friends/friendcookie_innerclose.png (a generic circular-X crop) restricted to a ROI around the inner X.
ROI WIDENED 2026-08-14 after a third variant turned up. Scanning all 1,401 archived unknown_screens frames for friendinfo_marker found 12 hits, hashes all distinct (11 separate events 08-03..08-11 plus one on 08-14), and they split into THREE layouts, not two:
• 'Friend's Info' alone — X at (1638,107), bbox (1598,68,80,78), pixel (1633,107) is the white glyph. close_popup handles it.
• 'Friend's Cookie' over Info — inner X bbox (1500,101,76,79), template centre (1570,127). The original roi=[1520,90,120,80] covered exactly this one (1.000) and nothing else.
• 'Friend's TREASURE' over Info — the common case, 11 of the 12 frames, identical coordinates every time: inner X bbox (1368,50,80,76), template centre (1423,88). The old ROI scored only 0.453 here, BELOW the 0.82 threshold, so the fallback never fired on the variant that actually keeps happening.
roi=[1360,50,240,110] covers both stacked layouts and still ignores what it must. VERIFIED THROUGH src.perceive.find, not a hand-rolled slice: 0.997 on all 11 Treasure frames (tap lands 1423,88), 1.000 on the Cookie frame (1570,127), 0.252 on the single-layer frame, and 0 false positives across 178 random non-friendinfo frames. A first attempt at [1350,50,240,80] looked correct against a hand-written slice that padded the box by the template size; the real ROI crops the frame to exactly (x,y,w,h) and requires the whole 55x55 template to fit inside it, so that box scored 0.169 on the Cookie layout — below threshold, silently reintroducing the bug it was meant to fix. Measure candidate ROIs by calling find() with roi=..., never by slicing the frame yourself. optional:true means a pass where only one layer exists is a silent no-op, not an error. Sequence: close_popup(outer, retries=1) → tap_template(inner, ROI-scoped, optional) → wait → close_popup(outer, retries=1) again to clear whatever layer is left — covers single-layer (first close_popup succeeds, inner tap is a no-op, second close_popup finds nothing and verifies clean) and two-layer (first close_popup fails on the outer coordinate every time, inner tap actually closes the Friend's Cookie card, second close_popup then reaches and closes the now-exposed Friend's Info X) without a blind unscoped tap ever firing.

run_result._note: Result popup after a run. Tap OK (702,940) — NOT 'Show Off'. After OK the Mystery Box screen appears on runs that collected a '?' box — the whole point of this bot — handled by mystery_box.

mystery_box._note: After Result-OK we either land on home, or the 'Mystery Box' screen blocks it. Detect the BOX screen positively. Present -> tap the closed box (960,540) and read the reward. Absent -> home (or a modal; home's probe chain handles it).

mystery_box_recheck._note: After collecting the box: Play! visible -> home is clear, continue the loop. Not visible -> something still covers it; go through probe_sendlife, never blind-tap.

probe_connectionlost._note: Connection Lost — server drop popup, can appear anywhere (head of the probe chain since nothing else works while offline). Text: 'Connection lost! Tap Confirm to restart the game and reload your data.' Not a dismiss: Confirm (960,700) actually restarts the client, so we hand off to restart_app (cycles the process the same way session_reset does) then the existing recover_login chain re-auths. Absent -> probe_inactive (rest of the popup chain).

probe_enterleague._note: Enter League — 'You have been entered in a League. Check out your position in the League Ranking!' Random season-start popup, can appear anywhere. Plain dismiss: Confirm (960,700) just closes it, no restart needed. Absent -> probe_inactive (rest of the popup chain).

probe_inactive._note: Home-side inactive guard. 'You've been inactive for a while. The game will restart!' can queue on/over home after a long idle. Confirm (953,690) lets the restart proceed, then hand to recover_login to re-auth. Absent -> probe_prevresults.

probe_prevresults._note: 'Previous Results / You have unreviewed game results' pops after a run that was cut short (e.g. by the inactive-restart). Confirm (950,680) opens the Result screen, then fall through to the normal chain which peels Result/MysteryBox/Congrats. Absent -> probe_dailycheckin (chain unchanged).

guard_not_inactive._note: Mid-run inactive guard. The inactive-restart popup can fire WHILE a run is on screen (Jump/Slide visible) when the bot stops feeding input -> observed live hanging the run. Confirm (953,690) -> recover_login re-auths. Absent -> the run is genuinely live: fall through to the original mid-run action (unchanged). RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here. RELAY (2026-08-03): the blind relay_tap here is gone. After the hop action we go through relay_stage1_jump_2/relay_stage2_jump_2, which detect the real two-stage Cookie Relay prompt and resume at jump_2 either way.

recover_login._note: Login recovery step 1 (DevPlay title). After the inactive-restart the game reopens on the DevPlay title with the orange 'DevPlay Login' button (devplaylogin_marker, self=1.0). Present -> tap it (960,950) to open the account picker, wait for the fade, hand to recover_pick. Absent -> we may already be at the picker (or past login) -> recover_pick.

verify_no_popup._note: Play-tap gate. The 'You've been inactive -> restart' popup overlays home/shop while Play! still scores ~0.87 through it, so home.on_match would tap Play INTO the popup and spin. Check inactive_marker first: present -> Confirm (953,690) -> recover_login re-auths. Absent -> no popup, run the real Play tap (original home.on_match body).

recover_pick._note: Login recovery step 2 (account picker). login_marker = 'You already have an account!' + CookieRun logo (name-agnostic). Present -> tap the top saved account row (1100,490), wait out the ~12s login + home load, re-enter start_state (home). Absent -> the picker isn't up (login already completed, or the title is still animating) -> go to start_state and let its own detection settle; if we're still on the title, home will be absent and the probe chain loops us back to recover_login.

verify_no_sendlife._note: Second Play-tap gate. A 'Send <name> a free Life?' dialog can sit ON TOP of home (or the boost shop) while Play! still scores 1.00 through it, same class of bug as the inactive-popup gate. Present -> Cancel (727,688 — gray/left, NEVER Confirm 1189,687) -> back to home to re-check. Absent -> no popup at all -> run the real Play tap (original verify_no_popup.on_absent body, unchanged).

verify_no_prevresults._note: Third Play-tap gate. 'Previous Results / You have unreviewed game results' sits ON TOP of home while Play! still scores 1.00 through it — same class of bug as the inactive and send-life gates. Without this the loop taps Play into the dialog forever: the popup does not cover the button, so home matches, the two existing gates find nothing, and probe_prevresults (which does handle it) is only reachable when home is ABSENT. Present -> Confirm (950,680), verified, then back to home. Absent -> the real Play tap.

verify_no_enterleague._note: Fourth Play-tap gate. The Enter League dialog is centred and leaves the Play button uncovered, so home matches at 1.00 through it and the loop would tap Play into the dialog — the same trap Previous Results fell into. probe_enterleague handles the popup but only runs when home is ABSENT. Present -> Confirm (960,700), verified, back to home. Absent -> the real Play tap.

probe_settings._note: User can manually open Game Settings (gear icon, top-right of home) at any time, on any tab (Options/Notifications/Performance/Game Info) -- no marker recognized this screen before, so the bot sat frozen matching nothing. Detect the teal 'Game Settings' title ribbon (shared by all 4 tabs); close via X (1671,145) -> home re-checks. Absent -> continue the normal chain.

probe_fortunebakery._note: 'Fortune Bakery' popup (fortune-cookie dough picker) can sit over home, covering Play!, with no auto-buy risk on our side (we never tap Select Dough). Detected by the teal 'Fortune Bakery' banner (boxrun/fortunebakery_marker.png). Close via X (1633,301 — scaled from a 1217x703 screenshot ratio, NOT yet CV-verified live; re-crop/re-measure on first live catch if the tap misses). Absent -> probe_prevresults (chain unchanged).

mb_open._note: Mystery Box screen — one self-looping dismiss state (replaces the mb_gate/mystery_box_reveal/mb_reveal_gate/mb_reveal_retry_2..6 chain, which claimed to cap at 6 dual-taps but retry_2 looped straight back to mystery_box_reveal so _3.._6 were dead and the loop was unbounded; mb_gate/mb_reveal_gate also detected inactive_marker while their notes described the Mystery Box screen). Each pass taps Open-all (960,965), box-center (960,540) and per-item Confirm (959,960) — covers both known layouts, a tap that hits nothing is harmless. Marker gone -> mystery_box_recheck. match_timeout_ms is the REAL bound on a stuck MATCH (timeout_ms only fires on the absent path). An inactive popup here covers the marker -> absent path -> recheck -> home's probe chain reaches recover_login, so the per-pass inactive check the old gates did is redundant.

probe_news._note: 'News' popup (patch notes / new-treasure announcements) opens ON TOP of home and fully covers Play! — home_play scores 0.263 through it vs 1.000 on a clear home — so it belongs to the probe family (reached when home is absent), not the verify_no_* family. Detected by the teal 'News' banner (news_marker: self=1.000, clear home=0.383 — clean separation, no threshold change). Close via the X at (1688,113), CV-verified live 2026-08-01. Re-appears after any client relaunch, which is how it arrived mid-night when adb dropped at 22:26 and the game restarted.

guard_not_news._note: Mid-run twin of probe_news, and the guard whose absence caused the 2026-07-31 livelock: News opened while the loop was in the `running` guard chain, all five guards missed it, and guard_not_inactive.on_absent concluded 'genuinely mid-run' and jumped — 389 cycles over 13h into a popup. probe_news cannot cover this: it is only reachable from the probe side. Same detect, same X.

recover_unknown._note: Progress-watchdog recovery entry (src/fsm.py no_progress_goto). Reached when nothing the config calls progress has happened for no_progress_s — i.e. the screen is something the FSM does not recognise. Detect home first: if the watchdog fired while home was actually up (a stalled run that already ended, say), there is nothing to recover and we rejoin the loop for free. Absent -> recover_unknown_probe, which spends one cheap pass through the known-popup chain before anything drastic.

recover_unknown_probe._note: Cheap half of the recovery: hand to the head of the probe chain, which peels every popup this config has a marker for and ends at home. Costs nothing but poll time and keeps a recognised popup from triggering a restart. If it works, the next watchdog window starts clean; if it does not, the watchdog fires again and lands on recover_unknown_restart — the escalation is the second fire, not extra logic here.

recover_unknown_restart._note: Expensive half, and the one that always works. Verified live 2026-08-01: the Events popup has no marker, is not closed by Android BACK, and survived a full probe-chain walk — the loop simply resumed jumping into it. A screen we cannot identify has no close button we can aim at, so cycle the process instead: restart_app -> recover_login re-auths -> home. Costs a life only if one was mid-run, and by definition the watchdog only fires when no run has been progressing for minutes.

probe_speed._note: SPEED GUARD: run must play with +17% base speed equipped. speedbase17_banner (the '+17% base speed' pill on the shop's right panel) shows whenever equipped — CV-verified 2026-08-02: equipped=1.000, shop-without-it=0.348, home=0.377. guard_not_partyrun._note: Close Party Run's 'Select a Mode' screen (added 2026-08-06). This screen had NO marker anywhere in the config, so the bot livelocked on it: every state missed, the guard chain and relay polls kept transitioning normally, and the hop taps landed on a menu instead of a run — a log that reads perfectly healthy while nothing progresses. It is reachable by accident because probe_friendinfo's blind tap (1633,107) lands in the Party Run banner strip when Friend's Info is not actually up (see that state's note). partyrun_marker.png is the purple 'Select a Mode' title bar cropped WITH its background colour — scores 1.000 here and <=0.403 on every other captured frame, unlike a text-only crop whose score would swing with the scene. on_match closes via the X at (1820,135) — the grey circle at the top-right of the SCREEN (area 4919, bbox 80x80 on a live Party Run frame). An earlier version tapped (1638,108), measured off the Friend's Info dialog by mistake; on the Party Run frame that point is dark background (BGR 93,53,51), so the guard detected the screen 38 passes in a row and never closed it. Measure the button on the screen you are closing, not a similar-looking one. CLOSE VERIFIED (2026-08-06): this used tap_xy + goto self, which is how those 38 passes stayed silent — a blind tap cannot tell a wrong coordinate from a slow fade, and self-looping on it produces no log line either way. close_popup re-reads the frame after the settle, taps again while the marker is still up, and log.warning()s if it never clears, exactly like guard_not_news does.

guard_not_friendinfo._note: Mid-run twin of probe_friendinfo, and the third instance of the 2026-07-31 News bug (added 2026-08-14). Friend's Info opens while the loop is in the `running` guard chain — a friend's card can surface on its own — and every guard in that chain missed it, so guard_not_inactive.on_absent concluded 'genuinely mid-run' and jumped into the popup. probe_friendinfo cannot cover this: it is only reachable from the probe side, which is why its hit count across four hours of live logs was ZERO while the player kept seeing the dialog. MEASURED on the archived frame unknown_screens/20260814_223452 (1920x1080, the watchdog happened to catch one): friendinfo_marker scores 0.974, partyrun_marker only 0.384 on the same frame, and the X is a grey circle bbox (1598,68,80,78) centred (1638,107) — pixel (1633,107) inside it reads BGR 255,255,255, i.e. the glyph itself. Same close sequence as probe_friendinfo, including the ROI-scoped inner-X fallback for the two-layer 'Friend's Cookie over Friend's Info' case; goto running rather than home because the run is still live behind the dialog.

probe_sdkfail._note: Failed to connect to server / SDK Code:0 — server-handshake failure at the title screen (added 2026-08-15). ROOT CAUSE OF A 10-HOUR DEAD WINDOW: on 2026-08-14 between 08:00 and 17:00 the bot banked ZERO games while firing the blind watchdog 14-17x/hr and calling restart_app 6-9x/hr. 166 of the 313 frames archived that day are this dialog. No marker matched it, so every state missed, the watchdog escalated to restart_app, the client came back up, failed the handshake again, and the loop repeated every ~7 minutes all day. probe_connectionlost does NOT cover it: that one detects 'Connection lost!' and scores only 0.648 here, below threshold — same dialog frame, different text. MEASURED: sdkfail_marker.png is the 'Failed to connect to server. SDK' text line cropped tight (50x770 at 575,405); 1.000 on all 30 sampled positives, max 0.321 across 60 sampled negatives, margin 0.679. Confirm is the green button, HSV blob bbox (744,614,431,147), centre (959,687). Like Connection lost, Confirm does not dismiss to gameplay — it drops to the title screen, so this hands off to restart_app then recover_login, exactly as probe_connectionlost does. Sits at the HEAD of the probe chain because nothing else in the chain can work while the client is offline.

probe_loginfailed._note: Login failed! Please try again. (added 2026-08-16, live-verified 2026-08-16 17:32-17:33) Appears after restart_app relaunches the client and the auto-login handshake fails once (observed once so far, immediately after a routine session reset). recover_login used to catch this by accident — its tap at (960,950) lands on the DevPlay Login button below this dialog, which happens to retry the login — but that only works because the dialog does not cover that button in this layout; nothing guarantees that stays true. This state taps the dialog's own Confirm button directly instead of relying on the coincidence. MEASURED: loginfailed_marker.png is the 'Login failed! Please try again.' text line cropped tight (50x720 at 600,440); scores 1.000 on the one live frame captured so far. Confirm button centre measured at (958,700) on that frame. Confirm retries the login and returns to the title/picker, same outcome as recover_login — so this hands off to recover_login to finish the sequence (idempotent: if login already completed, recover_login's own on_absent chain just falls through to home).

guard_not_sdkfail._note: Mid-run twin of probe_sdkfail (added 2026-08-15) — the FOURTH instance of the 2026-07-31 News pattern, and the one that cost the most: probe_sdkfail alone would not have caught the 10-hour dead window, because the frames were archived from relay_stage2_jump_3, jump_2 and running, i.e. the mid-run guard chain, where probe_* states are unreachable. Same detect and same Confirm as the probe-side state. Unlike the other guards this one canNOT return to running: Confirm drops the client to the title screen, so the run is already lost and the only correct move is restart_app + recover_login, same as probe_sdkfail.

guard_not_loginfailed._note: Mid-run twin of probe_loginfailed (added 2026-08-16), following the same pattern as guard_not_sdkfail: a probe-only fix cannot catch this dialog if it is seen while the recovery loop is mid-retry through the guard chain rather than the probe chain (the 2026-07-31 News pattern, repeated for SDK-fail on 2026-08-15 and now for this dialog). Like guard_not_sdkfail this canNOT return to running — the dialog only shows on the title screen, so the run is already lost and the only correct move is recover_login (not restart_app: the client is already up, just stuck on a failed login attempt, so cycling the process again would be redundant).

probe_mysterybox._note: Mystery Box seen from the PROBE side (added 2026-08-15). Fifth instance of the 2026-07-31 News pattern, and the first one caught by tools/screen_watch.py rather than by a watchdog: at 21:38 the screen sat on the Mystery Box 'Open all' page while the log walked the guard chain and the jump chain normally, i.e. the bot believed it was mid-run and was tapping jump/slide into a reward screen. The screen watcher reported it after 214s; the wall clock only fired at 601s, 387s later. The state table already had mystery_box and mb_open, with mb_open tapping exactly the right buttons — but mystery_box is reachable ONLY from run_result and mb_open, so once the loop was inside the run chain there was no path back to it. recover_unknown's probe walk went through all twelve probes and returned to `running` without touching it. Detect is the same marker mb_open uses; on_match hands straight to mb_open, which self-loops until the marker clears and then rejoins via mystery_box_recheck. Sits late in the chain, just before probe_sendlife, because it is a reward screen rather than a blocking popup — the launch-time popups ahead of it stay ahead of it.

guard_not_mysterybox._note: Mid-run twin of probe_mysterybox (added 2026-08-15), and the side that actually failed on 2026-08-15 21:38: the Mystery Box screen was up while the loop walked guard_not_* and the jump chain, so every guard missed, guard_not_inactive concluded 'genuinely mid-run', and jump/slide fired into a reward screen for ten minutes. probe_mysterybox cannot cover that — probe states are only reachable from the probe side. Hands to mb_open exactly as the probe does; mb_open self-loops on the same marker until it clears, so both entry points converge on one dismiss implementation.

Marker still up after 6 total taps across ~14s -> give up and fall through to home anyway; a popup this stubborn is better handled by home's own probe chain (or a human) than by burning more of the run on it.

_no_progress_comment: Progress watchdog (engine-side, src/fsm.py). Reaching any of ['home', 'run_result', 'mystery_box', 'check_heart'] resets the timer; 300s without one means the screen is something the FSM does not recognise — the 2026-07-31 News livelock jumped 389 times over 13h without tripping either existing livelock detector, because state kept changing and jump/slide count as actions. First fire tries the probe chain (recover_unknown); a second fire means that failed, so it cycles the app (recover_unknown_restart) — proven necessary live against the Events popup, which has no marker and ignores Android BACK.
_blind_lap_comment: Engine default is 160 polls, measured on boxrun_magnet's 32-state table. This table has 63 states and 19 of them drive off on_absent action lists (the jump chain and both relay polls), so a healthy lap walks far more absent edges per game than magnet ever did. Live 2026-08-14: eight fires in 31 minutes of healthy farming, every one at exactly 160, and fire #2 arriving 181s after fire #1 escalated to recover_unknown_restart and force-quit a run that was going fine — the watchdog was the only thing wrong. Real progress states (run_result -> mystery_box -> home -> check_heart) DO match every game, up to 443s apart, which is the window the ceiling has to clear. 600 is provisional: the engine now logs 'blind-streak peak N polls' whenever a match clears the streak, so replace this with the measured peak plus headroom once a few hours of log exist. Do NOT add 'running' to progress_states to dodge this — it detects result_marker.png by ABSENCE, never matches, and is reachable from probe_friendinfo.on_absent, the same path the 2026-07-31 News livelock rode; resetting on it would hand a stuck bot a fresh budget every lap.
_no_progress_s_comment: Raised 300 -> 600 on 2026-08-15 from measurement, not taste. Across 1,610 real inter-progress gaps in this repo's logs: median 64s, p90 302s, p99 439s — so 300 sat exactly at the p90 and **10.8% of healthy gaps (174 of 1,610) tripped it**. Live example 02:33:23: the wall clock fired on a run that was simply long, the Result popup rendered two seconds later, and the recovery walked the probe chain and reached run_result in 3s — correct behaviour recovering from a false alarm it should never have raised. 600 clears the p99 with 1.4x headroom and still sits well under the blind detector's reach (600 polls at ~0.48/s is ~1250s), so a genuinely stuck screen is still caught by whichever detector trips first. The 1771s max gap in that dataset was the SDK-handshake dead window, i.e. a real fault, and both detectors should fire on that.
